subject: MAP: schedule for traffic-replay load test & capacity sizing
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-02T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap + next: MAP milestone for load/perf test scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps focused on the MAP milestone for the load/perf test (traffic replay + dedicated capacity sizing):

- Goal: validate peak QPS behavior and confirm dedicated GPU sizing before pilot start.
- Proposed test window options: 2026-03-22 (low-risk weekend) or 2026-03-24 (weekday evening).
- Inputs we need from FastRetail: production traffic profile (sample CSV), peak QPS during promo windows, and allowed noise tolerance.
- Redwood will: run traffic replay against a dedicated pool in our staging region, capture latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), and produce a sizing recommendation.

Can you confirm the preferred test window and attach the traffic profile you mentioned on the call? I’ll pull Marissa in to draft the MAP milestones and responsibilities once we have those numbers.

Thanks —
Vivek
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fastretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fastretail.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next: MAP milestone for load/perf test scheduling

Vivek —

Appreciate the recap. We’re available for the weekend slot (Mar 22). Attached is a trimmed sample of our traffic profile and the quick notes from SRE:

- Typical peak QPS: 4,200 sustained over 10 minutes during promos; spikes up to ~7,500 for ~30s.
- Target SLA for promo pages: p95 < 450ms.
- We can provide a full 24h dump if you need it, but the attached sample covers the top 10% of requests.

Procurement is looped in for scheduling and any access/NDAs.

Thanks —
Alex
Lead Platform Engineer, FastRetail
[Attachment: fastretail_traffic_sample_trimmed.csv]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fastretail.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-04T18:30:00Z
Subject: MAP draft: Load test milestones, responsibilities, dependencies (v1)

Hi Alex / Vivek —

Following up with a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the load/perf milestone. This is v1 — treat as a working doc. Please comment or propose edits.

Milestone: Traffic-replay load & capacity sizing test
Target completion: 2026-03-24 (final sizing report delivered)

Milestone breakdown:
1) Data handoff — FastRetail provides traffic profile (sample + optional 24h dump)
   - Owner: FastRetail (Alex)
   - Deliverable: traffic_profile_2025q4.csv
   - Due: 2026-03-10

2) Test plan sign-off — Redwood shares test plan (replay tool, ramp, validation checks)
   - Owner: Redwood (Marissa)
   - Deliverable: test_plan_v1.pdf (inline in Drive)
   - Due: 2026-03-15

3) Staging preparation — provision dedicated pool and night-run baseline
   - Owner: Redwood (infra + runtime ops)
   - Deliverable: pool_config + baseline metrics
   - Due: 2026-03-21

4) Traffic replay execution — scheduled window (option: 2026-03-22 weekend or 2026-03-24 evening)
   - Owner: Redwood run team (Marissa), FastRetail monitoring (Alex)
   - Deliverable: replay logs, latency percentiles, tail latency analysis
   - Due: 2026-03-24 (if weekday chosen)

5) Sizing recommendation & next steps — dedicated capacity sizing and suggested pilot commit
   - Owner: Redwood (Marissa + Solutions)
   - Deliverable: sizing_report_v1.pdf
   - Due: 2026-03-26

Dependencies / Notes:
- We’ll need an allowlist IP range and short-lived access token for the replay ingest (security checklist attached).
- If FastRetail can only provide an aggregate sample, we may under/over-provision — we’ll surface uncertainty bounds in the sizing report.
- If peak QPS spikes above 8k during test, we recommend enabling burst capacity (est. +20% cost).

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Alex: confirm which test window you prefer (Mar 22 / Mar 24) and upload the CSV.
- Vivek: I’ll update the MAP in Drive and share a HubSpot task with deadlines.
- Aisha: can you own the security checklist and IP allowlist coordination?

Attachments (included): MAP_draft_v1.pdf, traffic_profile_2025q4.csv

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: traffic_profile_2025q4.csv]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference>, Procurement <procurement@fastretail.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-03-05T08:12:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Load test milestones, responsibilities, dependencies (v1)

Alex / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the sample CSV. FastRetail confirmed weekend (Mar 22) works — we’ll plan the replay for that window to minimize production noise.

Summary of agreed action items:
- FastRetail (Alex): upload full 24h dump by 2026-03-10 and provide allowlist IPs.
- Redwood (Marissa & infra): share final test_plan_v1 by 2026-03-15 and provision pool by 2026-03-21.
- Redwood (Aisha): security checklist + short-lived token flow (due 2026-03-12).
- Procurement (FastRetail): confirm any contractual prerequisites for weekend test (looped).

I’ll create the HubSpot task and send calendar invites for the test window. If anything shifts on your end, flag here and we’ll re-plan.

Best —
Vivek
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
